transcript.text: three kubernetes certifications that you
should definitely have as a devops
engineer the first one is the cka or
certified kubernetes administator exam
this exam focuses mainly on the admin
task like installing or upgrading
clusters taking HD backup managing
access to the cluster and lot more the
second exam is the ckad or certified
kubernetes application developer exam
this exam is designed mainly for
developers to build and deploy
applications on kubernetes ckad is
easier than cka so you can give CK ad
first and then cka the third important
kubernetes certification to have is the
certified kubernetes Specialist or the
cks exam which focuses mainly on the
security of the cluster and the
container applications running on it all
these exams are practical Hands-On based
where you will get 16 to 17 tasks to
perform and the cost for these exams are
$395 each with one free retake subscribe
for more
